knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Dilution is done only when the manufacturer specifies it and the workplace authorises it, and the mixture is not used if the calculation or label is uncertain.
The lesson requires labelling with identity, concentration and preparation details, a check against the instruction, and a clean station. Unlabelled or drink-container storage is named as an error.
Decanting into beverage bottles and improvised ratios are named as errors. Out-of-scope requests are referred for approval.
The confirm whether dilution is permitted section says to dilute a concentrate only when the manufacturer explicitly specifies it and the workplace authorises the task.

practicalCriteria: Learner sets up the work area and puts on the protective equipment named on the label before measuring, as confirmed by the supervisor.
Learner measures the concentrate and water with a graduated measure in the label order and reads the measure at eye level.
Learner labels the prepared dilution with product, dilution, date and initials, and the mix matches the approved dilution.
Learner dispenses using the low-misting or cloth method without spraying towards the face, then cleans the equipment and disposes of residue by the approved route.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Demonstration record with product, dilution, method, labelling and clean-up
Supervisor observation record against the criteria
stopWorkCriteria: Learner measures by eye or mixes a dilution that does not match the label or approved procedure
Learner dispenses towards the face or without the protective equipment named on the label
